query: making blurry photos sharp again
notes: 294 video deblurring, 346 survey of image deblurring, 382 sharp video from one motion-blurred image. Not 291/383 (general restoration) or 587 (rolling-shutter correction).

query: filling in the missing or removed parts of a damaged picture
notes: Image inpainting: 135 LaMa, 347 user-guided inpainting, 328 RePaint, 314 reference-guided inpainting, 203 fills regions hidden by moving objects (calls it inpainting). Not 3D completion papers (219, 545).

query: teaching a machine a skill by letting it watch an expert do it
notes: Imitation learning from demonstrations: 40 one human demo for a robot, 404 and 441 from video/observation, 434 demos plus preferences, 488 driving at crowded intersections, 674 expert demos. Six papers because the topic is that broad. Not 569 (representation pre-training) or 62 (mostly RL).

query: tricking neural networks with small changes people cannot notice, and protecting against such tricks
notes: Adversarial examples: 29 attack on classification and segmentation, 80 defense for image classifiers, 508 attacks and defense for 3D point-cloud classifiers. Not 232/265/61 (physical or driving-scenario attacks) or 627 (fooling explanations).

query: making a video of someone speaking from just a voice recording
notes: Audio-driven talking-head and speaking-portrait generation.

query: learning new things without forgetting old ones
notes: Continual learning: 494 ensembles against forgetting, 599 class-incremental learning, 655 semi-supervised continual learning, 399 online meta-learning for continual adaptation (least clear-cut). Not 175/548 (continual learning is a side point) or 185 (lifelong learning applied to exploration and active annotation, not to forgetting).

query: guessing the whole shape of an object when the scanner only saw part of it
notes: Object-level point-cloud / shape completion from partial scans. Scene-level completion (8, 545) left out because the query says object.

query: cleaning up noisy measurements from 3D scanners
notes: Point-cloud denoising / filtering. Not 3D face reconstruction from noisy images (192).

query: figuring out where in the world a photograph was taken
notes: 198 survey of geo-localization, 418 street-level images localized against aerial images. Not camera-pose re-localisation (160, 235) or indoor place recognition (157, 420).

query: turning a photograph into a pencil sketch
notes: 466 CLIPasso object sketches from images, 557 line drawings from photographs. 524 is sketch classification, not generation.

query: making a person in a video copy another person's dance moves
notes: Dance video retargeting. 54 (motion retargeting to a 3D character) left out: the target is not a person in a video.

query: generating in-between frames to make smoother slow motion video
notes: Video frame interpolation.

query: removing glare and reflections when shooting through a window
notes: Single-image reflection removal. Only paper on this topic in the corpus.

query: figuring out how far away everything is in a picture taken by a camera with a 360-degree view
notes: Depth estimation for 360-degree images: 197 multiview, 410 and 475 single image. Not 51 (room layout) or 544 (view synthesis).

query: working out where a robot should hold an object by splitting it into simple shapes
notes: Robotic grasping from primitive-shape decomposition. 63 is grasp motion for animated humans, 220/462/569 are other manipulation work.

query: translating what someone says into another language's voice without writing it down first
notes: Direct speech-to-speech translation. Only paper of its kind; the rest of the speech/NLP papers are not about translation.

query: turning a recording of several instruments playing into written music
notes: Multi-instrument automatic music transcription. Only music paper in the corpus.

query: a robot following written directions to find its way through a building
notes: Vision-and-language navigation. 185 and 246 are navigation papers without instruction following.

query: taking a 3D picture of the glowing gas swirling around a black hole
notes: BH-NeRF, 3D emission tomography around a black hole. Only astronomy paper in the corpus.

query: creating 3D objects from a written description
notes: Text-to-3D generation: 66 ClipMatrix textured meshes from text prompts, 563 text-guided 3D shape generation. 273 is text-to-image (2D).
